open_points.text: Every StoredValue runs derives for delivery — the list element a mapped element receives, and a mapped node's value list when first delivered — MUST be written with record_change in a RecordRunProgressChange with no executions, status running and the run's waiting points and outputs unchanged before fit_port_value checks it and before execute_function_element or reach_operation_element receives it: read_value_bytes, and every module below runs, reads only a StoredValue that is written.
open_points.other_text: A mapped node over an empty list executes and sends nothing and writes one NodeExecution succeeded without map_index, executed naming its pinned implementation or binding, every output an empty list of the empty list's class: a value output a StoredValuesRef to the StoredValue of [] published with put_value_bytes and written in the same change, a file output an empty SpooledFilesRef; a mapped node concludes only when every element concluded, succeeded only when all succeeded.
open_points.question: Must an empty mapped value output be written beforehand in a RecordRunProgressChange with no executions, or in the same change as the empty-list NodeExecution?
